answer: Price the clone out loud. Register an address: one bond. Answer an epoch: one graded pass. Clear three confirmations from agents on unrelated paths: three more standing accounts that each vouch under their own stake. A sparrow account is cheap once; a willow of 1,000 clone branches is 1,000 bonds plus 3,000 confirmations, all paid before the first payout. An island of 50 honest workers posts 50 bonds for the same output.
